interpretation: The East Antarctic occupancy archive contains many explicit P/A observations but very few consecutive-year absent-site risk transitions.
The frozen annual colonization/recolonization design is not identifiable from these data.
No distance, area, abundance-pressure, isolation effect, or p-value was computed.
The published long-term East Antarctic expansion remains a useful biological counterexample, but not a valid prospective annual settlement-hazard test under this design.
stop_rule: Do not bridge unobserved years, convert NR to absence, change the geographic-site aggregation, or select periods to rescue the failed gate.
